## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      3 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: May 6, 2026 - Aug 24, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Vipul Uchil_, Aug 23, 2026, 1/5: "app is more or less unusable after the latest update, which is definitely vibe coded because some MBA decided to fire all the UX professionals at the company. they took a perfectly intuitive and functional app and destroyed it for no reason at all. the new app is not user friendly in any way, actively prevents you from finding information, prevents you from quickly logging food. why would you ever use a food logging app when it takes you forever to log a single item of food? use cronometer."
            2. _enka cacka_, Aug 21, 2026, 1/5: "broken app, checkout doesnt work, guided onboarding flashing and annoying, cant add a meal adds pop up and screen freeze. what a joke"
            3. _Ein Google-Nutzer_, Aug 16, 2026, 1/5: "Demands an insane amount of access to your personal data. Also, the amount of ads has increased to a level that makes the app unusable."
